commit.message:
tests(metrics): add nnz, fpr, and directed-DAG regression coverage

The original 4 tests from a873bd5 cover TPR bounds but leave two
other metrics that were also corrupted by the double-counting bug
(issue #188) untested:

- nnz (pred_size): master returned 2 for a single bidirectional edge;
  fix correctly returns 1.
- fpr: master inflated false_pos_und by 2× for each undirected FP edge,
  causing fpr to double; fix gives the correct value (0.2 not 0.4 for
  the 1-FP-und-edge, d=4 case).

Also adds two directed-DAG regression tests to guard against future
changes accidentally breaking the pure-DAG (no undirected edges) path,
where master and fix must remain identical.

All 8 tests pass on the fix branch; all 3 TPR tests fail on master.
